text: The helper stops selecting a preference from isMove. The common copy caller selects dontPreserveOnCopy; the EWS caller selects copy or move and supplies StringFields output. LocalCopyHeaders always excludes storeToken, msgOffset, offlineMsgSize, ewsId and uidOnServer, then adds caller exclusions. Accepted later callers preserve that responsibility, and the asynchronous creation handler clones the array into owned state. The goal to remove the preferences remains discussion; both still exist in accepted callers. No copy/move or database operation ran.
title: Copy and move callers choose exclusions before LocalCopyHeaders
